source_gate.definition: implementation lines outside tests/docs/examples, counting .py plus Cython .pyx/.pxd
source_gate.why: A small upstream core cannot host an 80-150 LOC slice without the slice being most of the library, which lets copying pass. That is the Hard-50 failure mode (pass-conditioned copy median 0.66).

pilot_plan.policy: stratified by planned_lift_type (Adapted 5 / Composite 3 / Direct 2); within each stratum, candidates adding an uncovered feature_family win

rows.reassessment: Small register/dumps/loads surface over a global registry; branches are independent.

disable(name) makes later loads of that content-type raise ContentDisallowed unless force=True; dumps of the same serializer still succeeds

rows.reassessment: New card authored under the Closure-50 recipe. REJECTED BY SOURCE GATE: upstream core_loc 715 < 3000, so an 80-150 LOC slice would be most of the library and copying could pass.
rows.feature_one_liner: Circuit-breaker state machine plus listener notification
planned_branches: failure count reaching the threshold moves the breaker from closed to open
calls in the open state are refused rather than executed
after the reset timeout the breaker admits a single half-open trial
a failed half-open trial returns to open without restarting the count
listeners are notified of state changes and call outcomes in a fixed order
excluded exception types do not increment the failure count
rows.paper_fit: RQ1/RQ4: two coupled concerns (state machine plus listener registry) behind a two-method surface. Failures should land on contract closure, not localization.
rows.why_hard: A naive implementation does counting and thresholds only. The half-open single-trial semantics and the listener notification order are declared but easy to miss, and a shallow smoke test cannot distinguish them.
risks: reset timeout needs injectable time to keep the oracle deterministic
